ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-green elongated pieces with fibrous, layered leaf-like structure and a few cut edges, lying on the upper-left of the plate, about 7 cm long and 3 cm wide each, moist with slight sheen, holding shape; several pieces stacked | 75
ITEM 2 | Pale greenish-tan halved or quartered heart-like pieces with layered petal structure and cut ends showing pale interior, one piece with a darker browned edge, lower-left of the plate near the crumbly mass, about 6 cm across, moist, firm | 55
ITEM 3 | Off-white to pale cream crumbly chunks with flaky, fibrous texture and small bright specks, slightly moist, soft and loose, clustered in the lower-left of the plate covering about 1/6 of the plate area, roughly 5 cm across | 80
ITEM 4 | Small round beige-tan beads with matte, slightly wrinkled surface and uniform size about 1.2 cm diameter, dry looking, clustered in a loose mound on the right side of the plate, covering about 1/5 of the plate | 90
ITEM 5 | Deep reddish-brown to purple-black oval pieces, glossy and smooth skin, about 2.5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, some slightly wrinkled, arranged in a curved line on the lower right of the plate, firm and whole | 60
